da_op.text: Distributable Earnings is a non-GAAP measure, which we define as GAAP net income (loss) attributable to our common stockholders, including realized gains and losses from loan write-offs, loan sales and other loan resolutions (including conversions to REO), regardless of whether such items are included in other comprehensive income or loss, or in GAAP net income (loss), and excluding (i) non-cash stock compensation expense, (ii) depreciation and amortization expense (which only applies to debt investments related to real estate to the extent we foreclose upon the property or properties underlying such debt investments), (iii) unrealized gains (losses) (including credit loss expense (benefit), net), and (iv) certain non-cash or income and expense items.

prov.heading: Credit Loss Expense, net
prov.text: Credit loss expense, net increased by $5.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the three months ended June 30, 2026. The increase was primarily due to a $8.6 million expense recorded during the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $3.6 million expense during the comparable period. Credit loss expense during the three months ended September 30, 2026 was primarily due to a net increase of $3.5 million resulting from loan origination and full loan repayment activity during the quarter and a net increase of $5.1 million related to changes to the macroeconomic environment and underlying collateral performance. Credit loss expense during the three months ended June 30, 2026 was primarily due to a net increase of $2.1 million resulting from loan origination and full loan repayment activity during the quarter and a net increase of $1.5 million related to changes to the macroeconomic environment and underlying collateral performance. See Notes 3 and 16 to our Consolidated Financial Statements included in this Form 10-Q for additional details regarding our allowance for credit losses, risk ratings, and property type concentration risk.

ocf.heading: Operating Activities
ocf.text: During the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, cash flows provided by operating activities totaled $60.5 million and $65.7 million, respectively, primarily related to the change in accrued expenses and other assets during the period.

da.text: Distributable Earnings is a non-GAAP measure, which we define as GAAP net income (loss) attributable to our common stockholders, including realized gains and losses from loan write-offs, loan sales and other loan resolutions (including conversions to REO), regardless of whether such items are included in other comprehensive income or loss, or in GAAP net income (loss), and excluding (i) non-cash stock compensation expense, (ii) depreciation and amortization expense (which only applies to debt investments related to real estate to the extent we foreclose upon the property or properties underlying such debt investments), (iii) unrealized gains (losses) (including credit loss expense (benefit), net), and (iv) certain non-cash or income and expense items.

wc.text: Our existing loan portfolio may provide us with liquidity as loans are repaid or sold, in whole or in part, of which some proceeds may be included in accounts receivable from our servicers until released and the proceeds from such repayments become available for us to reinvest. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, loan repayments totaled $517.6 million. We held unencumbered loan investments with an aggregate unpaid principal balance of $187.2 million that are eligible to pledge under our existing financing arrangements. We also hold seven REO properties with an aggregate carrying value of $266.7 million. Two of our REO properties are financed and the remaining five properties are unencumbered and thus create financing capacity. Additionally, proceeds from the sale of REO properties may provide us with liquidity.

capex.text: During the nine months ended September 30, 2026, cash flows used in investing activities totaled $863.5 million primarily due to new loan originations of $1.3 billion, advances on loans of $100.1 million, and capital expenditures related to real estate owned of $7.1 million, partially offset by loan repayments of $510.1 million and cash assumed from conversion of loans held for investment to real estate owned of $0.2 million. During the nine months ended September 30, 2025, cash flows used in investing activities totaled $428.3 million primarily due to new loan originations of $928.2 million, advances on loans of $30.2 million, and capital expenditures related to real estate owned of $2.6 million, partially offset by loan repayments of $493.3 million and proceeds from the sale of real estate owned of $39.4 million.

net sales.heading: Other Revenue
net sales.text: Other revenue decreased $1.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the three months ended June 30, 2026, primarily due to a decrease in revenue from real estate owned operations attributable to a historical tax credit earned at one of our REO properties during the three months ended June 30, 2026.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income
Net interest income.text: Net interest income increased by $3.0 million to $26.7 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $23.7 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026. The increase was primarily attributable to an increase in interest income resulting from an increase in the outstanding balance of our investment loan portfolio. This increase was partially offset by an increase in interest expense resulting from an increase in the outstanding balance of our investment portfolio financing arrangements and a full quarter of interest expense related to the Term Loan B.

intro.text: TPG RE Finance Trust, Inc. is a commercial real estate finance company externally managed by TPG RE Finance Trust Management, L.P., an affiliate of TPG. Our principal executive offices are located at 888 Seventh Avenue, 35 th Floor, New York, New York 10106. We are organized as a holding company and conduct our operations primarily through TPG RE Finance Trust Holdco, LLC (“Holdco”), a wholly owned Delaware limited liability company, and Holdco’s direct and indirect subsidiaries. We conduct our operations as a REIT for U.S. federal income tax purposes. We generally will not be subject to U.S. federal income taxes on our REIT taxable income to the extent that we annually distribute all of our REIT taxable income to stockholders and maintain our qualification as a REIT.
